title: A public event page for an unlisted event tells search engines not to index it

source.ref: Scan nine (2026-10-19 weekly meta scan), docs/META-SCAN-STATUS.md

detail: public_event_by_slug admits visibility in ('public','unlisted') (20270124000000_public_events_narrow.sql), and ADR-202 says an unlisted event is a link, not a listing. generateMetadata sets robots only for past and series pages and always declares a canonical, so an unlisted event becomes indexable once a crawler sees the shared link, now that SCAN-867/876 made it a full page with a guest join box. The page has no visibility to test: the RPC does not return it and the anon enrichment read cannot see an unlisted row. Fix: return visibility from public_event_by_slug (a migration) or read it server-side, and set robots { index: false, follow: true } with no canonical for an unlisted event.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('app/(public)/events/[slug]/page.tsx','utf8');const i=s.indexOf('export async function generateMetadata');const b=i<0?'':s.slice(i,i+3500);if(!/unlisted/.test(b)){console.error('SCAN-1014: an unlisted event page carries no noindex');process.exit(1)}"
